text:
Pearls are typically found in oysters, mussels, clams, and scallops.

Adapting elements from the hip-hop genre to enrich the artistic concept of this exhibition, the narrative could frame the pearl not merely as a gem, but as a metaphor for urban resilience and hidden value. Just as hip-hop transforms the gritty, relentless pace of city life into rhythmic art, the pearl represents the transformation of irritation or stress within the oyster into something of profound beauty and worth. The "beats" of the playlist could mirror the rhythmic, protective layers of nacre being deposited over time, while the "lyrical flow" could echo the personal stories and struggles of city dwellers that are polished into strength. This conceptual layer adds depth to the visual art, suggesting that true elegance and value often emerge from the most challenging and chaotic environments.
